name: Habakkuk
author: Habakkuk.
setting: Habakkuk asks why God allows injustice in Judah and then why he uses Babylon.
theme: The righteous live by faith, trusting God even when circumstances are hard.

outline.label: I am doing a work: Babylon
Though the fig tree should not blossom

christInBook: Habakkuk 2:4, “the righteous shall live by his faith,” is quoted three times in the New Testament (Romans 1:17; Galatians 3:11; Hebrews 10:38). The just live by faith in Christ.
howToRead: Habakkuk is a conversation between the prophet and God. Follow the sequence: complaint, answer, complaint, answer, and then a prayer of trust.
